audit_instrumentation: BallisticMissileFly exposed read-only phase and ticks/speed/lazy state; movement branches and writes were unchanged.
IosHighUnitBenchmark created the real dmisl actor in a regular World and recorded one row per tick.
The clean release engine used an environment-gated skirmish entry hook because release-20250330 does not implement the working-tree Game.LaunchInto deep link.

The official x86_64 macOS SDL2, OpenAL, and freetype dylibs were replaced by local arm64 builds with SHA-256 c4c511601a07ad411a8f65c18d4ebcfa722ad76a44d2223b2a7de5c629368349, c88aae475848560f9ce5090dcee9c9b971b846562c9d5df588d5c8688d4c9b5f, and e9b16f11e5389f36102b477cadeacd3365a87a52248a1d7178dfa8f4bb3cecd5.

The unrelated 858x104 command-bar atlas (original SHA-256 3f3f6ad0b1a75d5738a37657fb4da29468a1308120137153329e20ab074951cb) was transparently padded to 1024x128 because the clean renderer rejects non-power-of-two sheet textures.

The clean engine returned disabled quantization for non-sprite actors without a quantization provider so unchanged dmisl could participate in sync hashing; BallisticMissileFly does not reference BodyOrientation.
